title: On the (Fourier analytic) Sidon constant of {0,1,2,3}
summary: This constant is the maximum of the sum $|c_0|+|c_1|+|c_2|+|c_3|$ of the moduli of the coefficients of a trigonometric polynomial $c_0+c_1e^{it}+c_2e^{2it}+c_3e^{3it}$ bounded by 1. Its value is still unknown, but I will present some ideas on how to compute it and describe a distinguished torus of extremal functions.
